---
name: "Design Build"
description: "Implement an approved visual direction as a complete, responsive interface"
argument-hint: "Describe the target and chosen direction"
agent: "agent"
---

Implement the requested interface using the anti-slop-design skill and the project's existing stack.

1. Inspect nearby components, tokens, assets, and conventions before editing.
2. Translate the chosen direction into a clear hierarchy, stable responsive layout, purposeful typography, semantic color, real content, and appropriate imagery.
3. Reuse existing design-system components. Use native controls for familiar interactions.
4. Build complete interaction, loading, empty, error, focus, and responsive states that the workflow requires.
5. Avoid generic centered compositions, decorative gradients or glows, excessive cards, redundant labels, and placeholder-style copy.
6. Validate behavior and rendering at mobile and desktop widths. Use screenshots when the environment supports them.

Make the edits and run the narrowest relevant checks. Do not stop at a proposal.
